label: Fabric
description: Named clothing fabrics, knits, lace, leather, technical textiles and embellished surfaces.
notes: Visible fabric structures, finishes and fibers with a recognizable surface belong here, phrased as material nouns after made of. clothing.cut owns garment construction; object.pattern owns printed motifs and named surface designs rather than the cloth itself. Generic satin and fluid silk charmeuse distinguish a smooth, fuller cloth from a thin, clinging drape; eyelet and broderie anglaise share one entry. Knitted luxury fibers are named as fabrics, and groups may overlap when a cloth is both sheer and embellished. Plain latex is treated as a material without assuming a fetish outfit.
